failure_scope: The stock HTTPS report and the native CLI/stock MCP report each passed on both Linux architectures. Those runs use 7fda192 and do not contain the later browser or v3 changes.

The broader PostgreSQL jobs on both architectures reached the export fixture privacy errors described in F546 and the workflow export fixture failures. The original native report steps continued and passed.
Both schema-68 restore jobs emitted metadata_exercise_failed. Their protected restore failure details are unavailable, leaving exact restore and access-control outcomes unverified.

Independent stock FTPS receiver runs passed in both ARM modes and failed in both x86 modes. The ARM FTPS producer passed and the x86 producer failed. The prior exact x86 version-refusal gate remains unresolved.

Native Chromium generated lineage passed. The separate original recipient UI journey remained red. The stock DAV receiver still failed the exclusive staging assertion, and stock application and broader DAV results remain red.
Core secret scanning, JavaScript dependency audit, Go reachability and all three native source vulnerability scans passed.
remaining: Run the browser and v3 report tests on the exact next candidate.
Preserve and resolve original restore, native protocol and broader runtime failures under their actual qualification gates.
